name: Tom Yum (vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 tbsp Thai chilli paste in oil (vegetarian nam prik pao, optional)
preparation: Simmer stock with lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves and chillies 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms, tomato and onion; cook 5 minutes.
Season with soy sauce, palm sugar, chilli paste and salt.
Off heat, add lime juice; top with coriander. The aromatics flavour the broth — push them aside while eating.

name: Tom Kha (coconut galangal soup)
preparation: Simmer stock with galangal, lemongrass and lime leaves 8 minutes.
Add coconut milk, mushrooms, tofu, chillies, soy sauce and palm sugar; simmer gently 6 minutes — do not boil hard.
Off heat, add lime juice and salt; garnish with coriander.

name: Glass Noodle Soup (Gaeng Jued Woon Sen)
preparation: Simmer stock with garlic 5 minutes.
Add cabbage, mushrooms and carrot; cook 4 minutes.
Add noodles, tofu, soy sauce, pepper and salt; simmer 3 minutes.
Finish with sesame oil, spring onion and coriander.

name: Pumpkin Coconut Soup (Thai style)
preparation: Sauté garlic and ginger in oil; add pumpkin, stock and lemongrass; simmer 15 minutes until soft.
Remove lemongrass; blend smooth.
Return with coconut milk, soy sauce, palm sugar and salt; warm through.
Finish with lime juice, chilli and coriander.

name: Khao Tom (Thai rice soup)
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic (sliced, fried golden in 2 tbsp oil)
preparation: Simmer stock with ginger 5 minutes; add rice and mushrooms, cook 8 minutes until porridge-like.
Add tofu, soy sauce, pepper and salt; simmer 3 minutes.
Top with the fried garlic and its oil, spring onion and coriander.

name: Tofu Satay with Peanut Sauce
preparation: Marinate tofu in coconut milk, curry powder, turmeric, soy sauce, palm sugar and garlic 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or pan-sear in oil 3 minutes each side until charred at the edges.
Serve with peanut sauce and cucumber relish.

name: Thai Corn Fritters (Tod Man Khao Pod)
ingredients: 1 tbsp vegetarian Thai red curry paste (see recipe)
preparation: Pulse half the corn coarsely; mix with whole kernels, flours, curry paste, lime leaves, soy sauce, sugar, coriander and salt.
Form small patties.
Deep-fry on medium until golden and crisp; serve with sweet chilli sauce.

name: Vegetable Curry Puffs (eggless)
preparation: Rub butter into maida and salt; bind with water; rest 30 minutes.
Sauté onion in oil; add potato, peas, curry powder, sugar and soy sauce; cool.
Roll dough, cut circles, fill, fold into half-moons and crimp.
Deep-fry on medium until golden, or bake at 200°C for 22 minutes.

name: Crispy Tofu with Sweet Chilli Dip
preparation: Pat tofu very dry; toss in cornflour, rice flour, pepper and salt.
Deep-fry until golden and crackly; drain.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce topped with peanuts and coriander.

name: Por Pia Tod (Thai fried spring rolls)
ingredients: 2 tbsp maida mixed with 2 tbsp water (for sealing)
½ cup sweet chilli sauce (to serve)
preparation: Stir-fry garlic, cabbage, carrot and mushrooms in oil 3 minutes; add noodles, soy sauce and pepper; cool.
Fill wrappers, fold sides, roll tight, seal with flour paste.
Deep-fry until golden; serve with sweet chilli sauce.

name: Money Bags (Toong Tong)
ingredients: ½ cup finely chopped water chestnuts or potato (boiled)
16 chive stems or spring onion greens (blanched, for tying)
½ cup sweet chilli sauce (to serve)
preparation: Mix corn, water chestnut, tofu, garlic, ginger, soy sauce and pepper.
Place filling in each wrapper, gather into a pouch and tie with a blanched chive.
Deep-fry on medium until golden; serve with sweet chilli sauce.

name: Miang Kham Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: ¼ cup palm sugar or jaggery
preparation: Simmer palm sugar, soy sauce and water into a thick syrup; cool.
Arrange leaves with little piles of peanuts, coconut, lime, ginger and chilli.
Spoon syrup into each leaf, fold and eat in one bite.

name: Grilled Corn with Coconut Glaze
preparation: Simmer coconut milk with palm sugar, salt and lime leaves until slightly thick.
Grill corn, turning, until charred in spots.
Brush repeatedly with the coconut glaze in the last 5 minutes; serve hot.

name: Thai Green Curry (vegetarian)
ingredients: 3 tbsp vegetarian Thai green curry paste (see recipe)
1 cup Thai eggplant or regular eggplant (chunks)
preparation: Fry the curry paste in oil and 3 tbsp thick coconut milk until fragrant and the oil splits.
Add remaining coconut milk, eggplant, beans, bamboo and lime leaves; simmer 10 minutes.
Add tofu, capsicum, soy sauce and palm sugar; simmer 5 minutes.
Off heat, stir in Thai basil; top with sliced chilli. Serve with jasmine rice.

name: Thai Red Curry (vegetarian)
ingredients: 3 tbsp vegetarian Thai red curry paste (see recipe)
preparation: Fry the curry paste in oil with thick coconut milk until aromatic.
Add coconut milk and pumpkin; simmer 10 minutes.
Add tofu, capsicum, broccoli, lime leaves, soy sauce and palm sugar; simmer 5 minutes.
Finish with Thai basil.

name: Massaman Curry (vegetarian)
ingredients: 3 tbsp vegetarian Thai red curry paste (see recipe)
preparation: Fry curry paste with cinnamon, cardamom and star anise in oil until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, potatoes and onion; simmer 20 minutes until tender.
Add tofu, peanuts, tamarind, soy sauce and palm sugar; simmer 8 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes before serving — massaman improves as it sits.

name: Panang Curry (vegetarian)
ingredients: 3 tbsp vegetarian Thai red curry paste (see recipe)
2 tbsp crushed roasted peanuts (in the paste)
preparation: Fry curry paste with crushed peanuts in oil until thick and fragrant.
Add coconut milk gradually, keeping the curry thicker than usual; simmer 5 minutes.
Add tofu, capsicum and beans; simmer 8 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and palm sugar; finish with sliced lime leaves.

name: Yellow Curry with Vegetables
ingredients: 3 tbsp vegetarian Thai red curry paste (see recipe)
preparation: Fry curry paste with curry powder and turmeric in oil.
Add coconut milk, potato, carrot and onion; simmer 15 minutes.
Add tofu, soy sauce and palm sugar; simmer 5 minutes.
Finish with lime juice.

name: Jungle Curry (vegetarian)
ingredients: 3 tbsp vegetarian Thai red curry paste (see recipe)
1 cup Thai eggplant or regular eggplant (chunks)
2 green peppercorn sprigs or 1 tsp crushed black pepper
preparation: Fry curry paste in oil until fragrant — no coconut milk in a jungle curry.
Add stock and bring to a boil; add all vegetables and lime leaves.
Simmer 10 minutes; season with soy sauce, palm sugar and peppercorns.
Finish with Thai basil. It should be thin, hot and herbal.

name: Pad Krapow Tofu (holy basil stir-fry)
ingredients: 1½ cups holy basil or Thai basil leaves
preparation: Pound or mince garlic and chillies together.
Stir-fry them in very hot oil 30 seconds; add crumbled tofu, sear 3 minutes.
Add beans, both soy sauces, mushroom sauce and palm sugar; toss 2 minutes.
Off heat, fold in the basil until just wilted. Serve over jasmine rice.

name: Pad Med Mamuang (cashew tofu)
preparation: Toss tofu in cornflour; shallow-fry in 2 tbsp oil until golden; set aside.
Flash-fry dry chillies and cashews 30 seconds; remove.
Sauté garlic, onion and capsicum 2 minutes; add sauces and sugar.
Return tofu, chillies and cashews; toss with spring onion.

name: Thai Basil Eggplant
ingredients: 2 large eggplants (bite-size wedges, soaked in salted water)
preparation: Sear drained eggplant in 3 tbsp oil until browned; remove.
Fry garlic and chilli in the rest; add capsicum 1 minute.
Return eggplant with sauces, sugar and water; cover 3 minutes until tender.
Fold in basil off the heat.

name: Pra Ram (tofu in peanut sauce over greens)
preparation: Warm the peanut sauce with coconut milk to a pouring consistency.
Arrange blanched greens on a plate, top with pan-fried tofu.
Pour the warm sauce over; finish with lime juice and crushed peanuts.

name: Choo Chee Tofu
ingredients: 3 tbsp vegetarian Thai red curry paste (see recipe)
preparation: Dust tofu in cornflour, pan-fry in 2 tbsp oil until crisp; set aside.
Fry curry paste in 1 tbsp oil; add coconut milk and reduce to a thick, glossy sauce.
Season with soy sauce and palm sugar.
Spoon over the tofu; scatter lime leaf shreds and chilli.

name: Sweet Chilli Ginger Tofu
preparation: Toss tofu in cornflour; shallow-fry until golden.
Fry ginger and garlic 1 minute; add capsicum.
Add sweet chilli sauce, soy sauce and lime juice; toss the tofu through.
Finish with spring onion.

name: Pineapple Red Curry
ingredients: 3 tbsp vegetarian Thai red curry paste (see recipe)
preparation: Fry curry paste in oil; add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add pineapple, tofu, tomatoes and lime leaves; simmer 8 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and palm sugar; finish with basil.

name: Vegetable Pad Thai (eggless)
ingredients: 300 g flat rice noodles (soaked in warm water 30 minutes)
½ cup garlic chives or spring onion (batons)
preparation: Simmer tamarind, palm sugar and soy sauce into the pad thai sauce.
Fry tofu in 2 tbsp oil until golden; push aside; fry garlic.
Add drained noodles and the sauce; toss on high, adding a splash of water if they stiffen.
Add sprouts and chives for the last 30 seconds.
Serve with crushed peanuts, chilli powder and lime.

name: Pad See Ew (vegetarian)
ingredients: 400 g fresh wide rice noodles (or 250 g dried, soaked)
2 cups Chinese broccoli or regular broccoli (cut)
preparation: Fry tofu in oil until golden; add garlic.
Add broccoli stems first, then leaves; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add noodles and all sauces with sugar; let the noodles sit and char slightly between tosses.
Finish with vinegar and white pepper.

name: Pad Kee Mao (spicy basil noodles)
ingredients: 400 g fresh wide rice noodles (or 250 g dried, soaked)
preparation: Fry garlic and chilli in hot oil; add tofu and sear.
Add baby corn and capsicum; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add noodles, sauces, sugar and peppercorns; toss on the highest heat until smoky at the edges.
Fold in basil off the heat.

name: Pad Woon Sen (glass noodle stir-fry)
preparation: Fry garlic in oil; add tofu and brown lightly.
Add cabbage, carrot and mushrooms; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add drained noodles, tomato, sauces, sugar and pepper; toss until the noodles turn translucent and absorb the sauce.
Finish with spring onion.

name: Khao Soi (vegetarian curry noodles)
ingredients: 300 g fresh wheat noodles (egg-free) + 100 g extra for crispy topping
oil for deep frying the topping (about 2 cups)
3 tbsp vegetarian Thai red curry paste (see recipe)
½ cup sliced shallots or onion
1 cup pickled mustard greens or cucumber relish (see recipe)
preparation: Deep-fry the extra noodles until crisp; set aside.
Fry curry paste with curry powder; add coconut milk and stock; simmer 10 minutes.
Add tofu, soy sauce and palm sugar; simmer 5 minutes; finish with lime juice.
Boil the fresh noodles; divide into bowls, ladle curry over.
Top with crispy noodles, shallots, coriander and pickles.

name: Thai Pineapple Fried Rice
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add curry powder 30 seconds.
Add rice, soy sauce and sugar; toss on high.
Fold in pineapple, peas, cashews and raisins; toss 2 minutes.
Finish with spring onion; serve in the pineapple shell if you have it.

name: Thai Basil Fried Rice
preparation: Fry garlic and chilli in very hot oil.
Add capsicum and beans; stir-fry 1 minute.
Add rice, soy sauces and sugar; toss on the highest heat 2 minutes.
Fold in basil off the heat.

name: Coconut Rice
preparation: Bring coconut milk, water, sugar, salt and pandan to a simmer.
Add rice, cover, cook on lowest heat 15 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes; fluff and top with toasted coconut.

name: Steamed Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice (rinsed until the water runs clear)
preparation: Bring rice, water and salt to a boil.
Cover, reduce to the lowest heat, cook 12 minutes.
Rest off heat 8 minutes; fluff gently.

name: Thai Sticky Rice
ingredients: 2 cups Thai glutinous rice (soaked 4 hours or overnight)
preparation: Drain the soaked rice; spread in a cloth-lined steamer basket.
Steam over boiling water 20–25 minutes, flipping the mass once, until translucent and chewy.
Sprinkle salt, keep wrapped in the cloth; eat with curries by hand.

name: Yum Woon Sen (glass noodle salad)
ingredients: ½ cup finely sliced shallots or onion
¼ cup fresh coriander and mint
preparation: Whisk lime juice, soy sauce, palm sugar and chilli into a hot-sour dressing.
Toss warm noodles with tofu, tomatoes, shallots and celery in the dressing.
Top with peanuts and herbs; serve at room temperature.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice with Crispy Garlic
ingredients: 4 tbsp sliced garlic (fried golden in 3 tbsp oil, oil reserved)
preparation: Stir-fry vegetables in the garlic oil 2 minutes.
Add rice, soy sauce, sugar and pepper; toss on high 3 minutes.
Top with the crispy garlic and spring onion; serve with cucumber and lime.

name: Pad Pak Boong (garlic water spinach)
ingredients: 500 g water spinach or regular spinach (cut into lengths)
1 tbsp fermented soybean paste (tao jiew, optional)
preparation: Mix all sauces, sugar and water in a bowl.
Heat oil until smoking; add garlic, chilli and greens together.
Pour the sauce over and toss 60–90 seconds only — the stems should stay crunchy.

name: Stir-fried Mixed Vegetables (Pad Pak Ruam)
ingredients: 4 cups mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrot, baby corn, snow peas, mushrooms, cabbage)
1 tsp cornflour mixed in 1 tbsp water
preparation: Fry garlic in hot oil; add the hard vegetables first, then the rest.
Add sauces, sugar and stock; toss 2 minutes.
Thicken with slurry; finish with white pepper.

name: Vegetarian Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 2 kaffir lime leaves or 1 tsp lime zest
preparation: Grind the toasted seeds and peppercorns to a powder.
Pound or blend everything into a smooth, thick paste, adding oil as needed.
Store refrigerated 2 weeks or freeze in portions. No shrimp paste — fully vegetarian; the salt replaces it.

name: Vegetarian Thai Green Curry Paste
ingredients: 2 kaffir lime leaves or 1 tsp lime zest
preparation: Grind toasted seeds and peppercorns to a powder.
Blend all ingredients into a smooth green paste with the oil.
Store refrigerated 2 weeks or freeze in ice-cube portions.

name: Peanut Sauce
ingredients: ¾ cup roasted peanuts (ground) or smooth peanut butter
1 tbsp vegetarian Thai red curry paste (see recipe)
1 tbsp tamarind paste or lime juice
preparation: Warm coconut milk with the curry paste 2 minutes.
Add ground peanuts, palm sugar, soy sauce, tamarind and water.
Simmer, stirring, to a thick pourable sauce. Thin with water when reheating.

name: Som Tam (vegetarian green papaya salad)
ingredients: ½ cup green beans (cut, lightly crushed)
preparation: Pound garlic and chillies in a mortar; add beans and bruise.
Add palm sugar, lime juice and soy sauce; mix.
Add papaya and tomatoes; pound and toss lightly together.
Top with peanuts. No dried shrimp, no fish sauce — soy and lime carry it.

name: Ajad (cucumber relish)
ingredients: 3 shallots or ½ small onion (thinly sliced)
preparation: Warm vinegar, sugar, salt and water until dissolved; cool completely.
Pour over cucumber, shallots and chilli.
Rest 15 minutes; serve with satay and curry puffs, topped with coriander.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
ingredients: 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds or crispy mung beans
preparation: Steam the soaked rice in a cloth-lined steamer 25 minutes.
Warm 1 cup coconut milk with sugar, ½ tsp salt and pandan; pour over the hot rice, cover 20 minutes to absorb.
Simmer the remaining coconut milk with ¼ tsp salt into a salty-sweet topping.
Serve rice with mango, the topping and sesame.

name: Banana Roti
preparation: Knead maida, water, sugar, salt and oil into a very soft dough; rest 30 minutes in oiled balls.
Stretch each ball paper-thin on an oiled surface.
Place banana in the centre, fold into a parcel.
Pan-fry in butter until golden and crisp on both sides; drizzle condensed milk and sugar, cut into squares.

name: Tub Tim Krob (water chestnut rubies)
ingredients: 3 tbsp rose syrup or beetroot syrup (for colour)
preparation: Toss water chestnut pieces in the red syrup 10 minutes, then drain and coat thoroughly in tapioca flour.
Boil until they float and turn glassy; drop into iced water.
Dissolve sugar and salt in coconut milk.
Serve the rubies over crushed ice with the coconut milk and jackfruit.

name: No-churn Coconut Ice Cream
preparation: Whip the cream to soft peaks; fold in thick coconut milk, condensed milk and salt.
Freeze in a lined tin 6 hours, stirring once after 2 hours.
Scoop and top with toasted coconut and peanuts.

name: Thai Iced Tea
ingredients: 4 tbsp Thai tea leaves or strong black tea
½ cup milk or evaporated milk
preparation: Boil the tea in water 5 minutes; strain; dissolve the sugar while hot; chill.
Fill glasses with ice, pour the tea three-quarters up.
Float condensed milk and milk on top; stir at the table.
